Jade_Aatrox.name: Aatrox
Jade_Aatrox.title: The Darkin Blade
Jade_Aatrox.lore:
- The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions.
- Blood Well (P) has a revive component.
Jade_Aatrox.blurb:
- The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions.
- Blood Well (P) has a revive component.

spells.name: Dark Flight
spells.description: Aatrox takes flight and slams down at a targeted location, dealing damage and knocking up enemies at the center of impact.
spells.tooltip: Aatrox takes flight and slams down dealing <physicalDamage>{{ qdamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to all nearby enemies and <status>Knocking Up</status> targets at the center of impact for {{ qknockupduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blood Thirst / Blood Price
spells.description: While toggled on Aatrox deals bonus damage every third subsequent attack at the expense of his own Health. While toggled off Aatrox restores Health every third subsequent attack.
spells.tooltip:
Toggle: Aatrox switches between Blood Thirst and Blood Price, gaining bonus effects on every third attack.

Blood Thirst: Aatrox restores {{ wheal }} Health, increased to {{ lowhealthheal }} when below {{ lowhealthpercent }}% Health.

Blood Price: Aatrox deals {{ wdamage }} bonus physical damage and loses {{ selfdamage }} Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blades of Torment
spells.description: Aatrox unleashes the power of his blade, dealing damage to all enemies hit and slowing them.
spells.tooltip: Aatrox unleashes the power of his blade, dealing <magicDamage>{{ edamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all enemies hit and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ eslowamount }}% for {{ eslowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Massacre
spells.description: Aatrox draws in the blood of his foes, damaging all nearby enemy champions around him and gaining increased Attack Speed and bonus Attack Range for a short duration.
spells.tooltip: Aatrox draws in the blood of his foes, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all enemy champions around him, increasing his <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ rattackspeed*100 }}%</attackSpeed>, and gaining <attention>{{ rbonusrange }} Attack Range</attention> for {{ rduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Blood Well
passive.description: When using an ability that costs Health, Aatrox stores the self-inflicted damage into the Blood Well. Upon taking fatal damage Aatrox extracts the blood from the well and recovers it as health over a brief duration. Additionally, Aatrox gains 1% Attack Speed for every 2% blood that is in the well.
